text: After two years working in Singapore, Husin [returns home to Kampung Pisang|trigger|going back home] and finds his neighbour Kak Limah silent, her hair wild, and his nights full of frights. The villagers at Pak Jabit's stall argue over whether she has become a ghost, and they find her [nearly rotted body inside her house|images|corpses and body parts]. Even after the burial, [something still haunts the village at night|threat|the restless dead], and [no shaman can drive it away|rules|nothing can stop it].
